_comment: Mozilla-style JSON update manifest, served raw from this repository's main branch and named by manifest.json's applications.zotero.update_url. Ticket 0688: the URL there was https://example.invalid/..., an RFC 2606 address guaranteed never to resolve, so every update check the plugin made failed against a name chosen to fail. The id keeps its .invalid suffix and correctly so -- Zotero never dereferences an id, only this URL. The updates list is EMPTY on purpose: it is the documented idiom for 'no update available', and it is the honest answer for a plugin hand-delivered as an XPI, since there is no published release and nothing here may point at a download link that does not exist. No claim is made either way about what an empty list or an unreachable update_url does to an installed add-on -- that was not established against Zotero's own fork, and this file is a fix for a URL that could not resolve, not a diagnosis. Publishing releases means adding an entry per release with update_link and applications.zotero version bounds.
